# Angular 16 — Folder and File Structure

[← Back](https://github.com/joycequoos/FullStackAngular16_DotNet/blob/main/README.md)

When an **Angular 16** project is created using the Angular CLI (with the command `ng new project-name`), it already generates a complete file and folder structure, designed for scalability and good practices. This guide summarizes the initial structure and what each part is for.

## Folder Structure Generated by Angular 16

```
my-project/
├── node_modules/
├── src/
│   ├── app/
│   │   ├── app.component.ts
│   │   ├── app.component.html
│   │   ├── app.component.css
│   │   └── app.module.ts
│   ├── assets/
│   ├── environments/
│   ├── index.html
│   ├── main.ts
│   └── styles.css
├── angular.json
├── package.json
├── tsconfig.json
└── README.md
```

## Understanding Each Part

### `node_modules/`

- Folder where all of the project's **dependencies** live (Angular libraries, among others).
- Created automatically when running `npm install`.

### `src/`

Where the application's **source code** lives — components, modules, services, and routes.

- `app.component.ts` — logic for the main component (`AppComponent`).
- `app.component.html` — HTML for the `AppComponent`.
- `app.component.css` — styling for the `AppComponent`.
- `app.module.ts` — the **root module**, where components are declared and other modules are imported.

### `src/assets/`

- Where images, fonts, and other static files used in the front end are kept.

### `src/environments/`

- Defines the application's environment variables:
  - `environment.ts` — **development** environment.
  - `environment.prod.ts` — **production** environment.

### `src/index.html`

- The application's base HTML — this is where Angular injects the app.

### `src/main.ts`

- The Angular application's **entry point**.
- Loads the `AppModule` and bootstraps Angular.

### `src/styles.css` (or `styles.scss`)

- The application's global styling.

## Configuration Files at the Project Root

| File | Description |
|---|---|
| `angular.json` | The Angular project's configuration file — defines build, styles, assets, scripts, and other CLI settings. |
| `package.json` | Lists the project's dependencies (Angular and third-party libraries) and the available scripts (such as `ng serve`, `ng build`). |
| `tsconfig.json` | TypeScript compiler settings, used throughout the project. |
| `README.md` | Standard documentation automatically generated by the Angular CLI when the project is created. |
